how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CMD Project Executive Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CMD to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply

To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CMD to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CMD Project Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Executive post at Centre for Management Development is 22-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Executive post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Com or MBA (Finance) degree to be eligible for the Project Executive position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Executive role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Project Executive post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Executive position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Executive role will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 23000 to Rs. 27000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Executive post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Executive post announced by the Centre for Management Development.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for the Project Executive position through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Executive role includes a Proficiency Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the CMD Project Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the Centre for Management Development Project Executive recruitment is CMD/DS/HR/003/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Centre for Management Development located?
faq.answer: The Centre for Management Development is located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with the pincode 695014.
